profile_text.body:
Palantir, founded in 2003 and headquartered in Palo Alto, builds software for integrating data, decisions, and operations across organizations. The company describes itself as delivering foundational software of tomorrow, today. It is a publicly traded company.

The company's primary AI product is Palantir AIP, an enterprise AI platform built on ontology-based governance. Palantir positions AIP for high-stakes decision influence in defense and intelligence contexts, reflecting the company's historical focus on those sectors.
